recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is. Revisit only if a future rendered core extension page loses the Context of Use section or places it below the extension definition/content in a way that obscures where the extension can be used.
issue_request: FHIR-5908 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request asking that the context where an extension can be used be made more obvious, preferably near the top under the extension URL.
initial_application: The Jira comments identify svn revision 4539. The imported git commit 465b04a3a62118caa464d86396fce67add7a69e4 is that revision and added the <%context-info%> placeholder to source/template-extension.html, backed by describeExtensionContext rendering support in the old publisher code.
additional_context: The current source has moved the extension template to tools/templates/template-extension.html, where the official URL appears in the top metadata block and <%context-info%> renders before the Definition section. Active [profiles] entries in source/fhir.ini still feed FHIR-core extension definitions through this template family, and StructureDefinition.context plus the Defining Extensions page consistently explain extension use contexts. Corrected Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current template already exposes Context of Use prominently before the extension definition/content, so moving or duplicating it would be editorial churn rather than a necessary current-spec correction.
